subject: Cross-border activation window, DTIA evidence & subprocessor rollforward
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@medsecure.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: MedSecure Procurement <procurement@medsecure.com>
Date: 2025-05-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: DTIA + activation window for EU processing

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. We are ready to move forward but need a clear activation window for when Redwood will begin processing EU subject data in production (SCCs and the UK IDTA addendum both need to be signed before any go-live). Procurement also needs the DTIA questionnaire answered and an up-to-date subprocessor inventory.

Could you: 1) confirm the signature cadence for SCCs + UK addendum (do you require a separate DocuSign for the UK Addendum?), 2) provide the latest subprocessor CSV and 3) propose a 2-week activation window (target earliest go-live). We prefer a rolling activation where higher-risk processors are enabled last.

I attached our DTIA_questions.pdf with specific asks.

Thanks,
Sarah Klein
Legal Ops — MedSecure
Attachment: MedSecure_DTIA_questions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@medsecure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-30T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: DTIA + activation window for EU processing

Hi Sarah — thanks for the detailed list. Quick answers up front:
- SCCs + UK addendum: We generally present a single execution packet that includes the EU SCCs (controller-processor) and a separate UK IDTA addendum. Both are DocuSign-enabled; the UK addendum signs as an addendum line-item. We'll confirm if legal prefers separate signers.
- Subprocessor inventory: attaching our current export (CSV) — includes deployment regions and data flow notes.
- Activation window: propose the week of 2025-06-16 to 2025-06-20 as the earliest production window, with a 3-step rollforward (canary, staged, full). Higher-risk subprocessors (listed in row 4-7 of the CSV) will be scheduled for the final stage.

Action items I'm taking:
1) Kimberly — confirm the canary/staging capacity and whether KV cache fallbacks will be enabled for the canary stage.
2) Laura — will you review the DTIA questionnaire answers and note any evidence gaps (HSM/KMS, audit logs, processor-level TLS cert rotation cadence)?

I'll share a formal activation_timeline_v1.xlsx by EOD.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Security Partnership Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_202505.csv (text/csv)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@medsecure.com>
Date: 2025-05-31T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: DTIA + activation window for EU processing

On 2025-05-30 Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Activation window: propose the week of 2025-06-16 to 2025-06-20 as the earliest production window, with a 3-step rollforward (canary, staged, full).

Jonas — I'll confirm infra capacity for the canary on Monday. Two notes on subprocessors:
1) The CSV indicates one new analytics subprocessor (EdgeFlux) scheduled to be activated in mid-June; Legal flagged that for additional attestation — we should keep EdgeFlux in the final rollout batch.
2) For audit evidence, MedSecure asked for KMS/HSM attestation and retention/egress policies. We have exportable artifacts but need to sanitize internal IPs before handing them over. Laura, can you confirm the minimum artifact set so we can produce a redacted package?

Kimberly
Senior Cloud Ops Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@medsecure.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-01T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: DTIA + activation window for EU processing

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the questionnaire. I reviewed the PDF and drafted answers in the shared draft (link below). Short summary of gaps and mitigations:
- KMS/HSM: we can provide HSM attestation and key custody diagrams. Redaction required for internal identifiers — ETA for redacted pack: 2025-06-05.
- Audit logs: we can export per-tenant token-level logs for the requested 90-day window; we also have a sampling plan if you need longer retention.
- Subprocessor attestation: EdgeFlux has SOC2 Type II certs but is still in a 30-day remediation window for a minor control gap; recommend delaying EdgeFlux activation until remediation confirmed.

I'll post the redacted artifact bundle to the SharePoint folder and update the activation_timeline_v1.xlsx to push EdgeFlux into the final stage (canary -> staged -> full).

Link: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/Legal/EQJd-example

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Legal Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachment: activation_timeline_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@medsecure.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: MedSecure Procurement <procurement@medsecure.com>
Date: 2025-06-02T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: DTIA + activation window for EU processing

Thanks team — this is helpful and aligns with our risk approach. A few follow-ups:
- MedSecure confirms we want EdgeFlux delayed to the final activation stage until we review the remediation evidence.
- For the UK IDTA: procurement prefers a single DocuSign packet where the UK addendum is an explicitly checked addendum line; please include a separate signature block for our UK legal rep.
- Please upload the redacted HSM attestation and the subprocessor CSV to the SharePoint folder and notify us when ready.

Once we review the redacted artifacts and sign the SCCs + UK addendum (anticipated by 2025-06-12), we will confirm the 2025-06-16 canary kickoff.

Regards,
Sarah Klein
Legal Ops — MedSecure
Attachment: none
